description: A CPA-facing tax return review workspace prototype. It is calm, trustworthy, inspectable, and professional. Deep data density with clear auditability.

fonts.name: Chivo
fonts.usage: Headings, primary UI navigation, and titles. Provides a clean, technical, and authoritative feel.

fonts.name: IBM Plex Sans
fonts.usage: Primary body text, standard form fields, paragraphs. Maximizes legibility for dense UI.

fonts.name: IBM Plex Mono
fonts.usage: Data fields, dollar amounts, confidence scores, dates, and audit log timestamps. Crucial for CPAs to align and read numbers quickly.

layouts.app_container: h-screen w-full flex flex-col bg-slate-50 overflow-hidden
layouts.header: h-14 w-full bg-white border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between px-4 z-50 shrink-0

panels.left_nav: w-64 bg-white border-r border-slate-200 overflow-y-auto flex-shrink-0
panels.right_evidence: w-[450px] bg-white border-l border-slate-200 overflow-y-auto flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col

TaxFieldRow.description: A dense row displaying tax fields. Hover state is crucial for scannability.
TaxFieldRow.classes: flex items-center justify-between p-3 border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-md mb-2 hover:border-slate-300 hover:shadow-sm transition-all group
TaxFieldRow.elements: Label (IBM Plex), Value Input/Display (IBM Plex Mono), Status Badge, Action Menu (lucide-react icons)

StatusBadges.AI_Generated: bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 border border-sky-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1
StatusBadges.Verified: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1
StatusBadges.Needs_Review: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1
StatusBadges.Locked: bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border border-slate-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1

DocumentPreview.description: Simulated document viewer showing where the AI extracted data from.
DocumentPreview.container: relative w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-slate-100 overflow-hidden
DocumentPreview.highlight_box: absolute border-2 border-amber-500 bg-amber-400/20 rounded-[2px] cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-amber-400/30

Tabs.active: px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 border-slate-900 text-slate-900
Tabs.inactive: px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700

motion.transitions: Use subtle, quick transitions (150ms). Focus on opacity and border-colors. NO bouncy or dramatic animations. This is a CPA tool.
motion.hover_states: Interactive elements should slightly darken or gain a 1px border. Do not use heavy drop shadows.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AA. Ensure text on badges has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, inputs, and badges MUST include data-testid attributes.

tax_document_w2.description: Simulated 1040/W-2 document for evidence extraction preview

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application exclusively using React (.js/.jsx), Tailwind CSS, and lucide-react icons. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Implement a 3-panel workspace architecture with a non-scrolling full-height container ('h-screen overflow-hidden') and independently scrolling panels.
Utilize IBM Plex Mono heavily for all numerical values, confidence scores, and IDs.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, dialogs, dropdowns, or headers. Use solid backgrounds ('bg-white') with a border and subtle shadow.

Avoid glowing effects, gradients, and typical AI 'sparkle' icons. Use a clinical, technical aesthetic. 'AI-generated' is indicated by a subtle sky-blue pill badge and a 'BrainCircuit' or 'Cpu' icon from lucide-react.

Implement the Document Preview by placing the 'tax_document_w2' image in a relative container and absolutely positioning a div over it to simulate an AI extraction zone highlight ('bg-amber-400/20 border-2 border-amber-500').
All correction workflows (modals/popovers) must have a required text area for 'Reason for change' to maintain the audit trail.
Do NOT center align form fields or data rows. Everything should be strongly left-aligned or tabular.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, but customize padding and fonts to be denser.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., 'transition: all'). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the CSS.
Use 1px borders and distinct solid colors for hierarchy, rather than deep shadows.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., 'data-testid="accept-ai-button"').
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (e.g. brain or robot). Rely strictly on 'lucide-react'.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications located in '/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js'.
